summary: Post-r0107 hardening. collectstatic under the updater's UMask=0077 no longer leaves nginx-unreadable static entries and repairs existing 0700/0600 ones; every destination operation is descriptor-confined (STATIC_ROOT must be symlink-free; --link unsupported). VoiceTrack previews play the current take. Monitoring watches isadoraair-validation (add the Monitor Check row after install). iPortal punch-in labels and reopen state. collectstatic; Gunicorn+Monitoring restart; no migrations; runtime 12.
